title: Wildfire Watch
description: *Wildfire Watch* is a **live wildfire map for Europe built to judge risk**, not only to show where fires are. NASA satellite hotspots, wind, the official EFFIS fire danger forecast, burnt areas and the towns near each fire share one map.

Every source is **free and needs no key**. The NASA fire files cannot be read by a web page, so a scheduled GitHub Action copies them every 30 minutes. Hot pixels from four satellites are joined into fires, and a fire seen by two satellites is marked as cross-checked.
A demo mode shows the original design on invented data. The clustering, alerts, danger score and spread shape are **pure modules covered by tests written before the code**.
